name: Emergent
verdict: A prompt-to-app builder for web and mobile; Standard is $20 a month for 100 credits, and the next plan is $200.
pros: Web and mobile apps from a prompt
Free plan to see the credit meter
Annual prices are printed on the card
cons: Pro is ten times the Standard price
Extra-credit pack prices are not on the pricing page
pricingNote: On emergent.sh/pricing, checked 2026-10-15. Free is $0 a month with 10 free monthly credits. Standard is $20 a month, or $17 a month on the annual price, which the card labels Save $36, with 100 credits a month. Pro is $200 a month, or $167 a month annual, labeled Save $396, with 750 monthly credits. Enterprise is Custom. Standard says you can purchase extra credits and does not list the pack prices, so none are shown.
